question: GQ-009
subject: declaring a reproducer surfaced four defects the gate could not previously see
the_move: The GQ-008 cache reproducer existed and was never declared on the two metrics files it reproduces. That is exactly what let me hand-roll a different probe last turn and nearly report a false regression. Declared it.

what_declaring_it_exposed.cause: the derivation counted ALL numbered headings; the page counts only UNSTRUCK ones. Two correct implementations of two different questions under one label.
what_declaring_it_exposed.also: I had inserted decision 8 before decision 7 in the file
what_declaring_it_exposed.fix: the derivation now excludes struck-through and RESOLVED headings, matching blockedDecisions()

what_declaring_it_exposed.cause: I MOVED that 10.2 GB file to the vault today and left the derivation pointing at the old root path
I added two self-test cases today and did not update the number I had declared
what_declaring_it_exposed.note: caught only BECAUSE it was declared — an undeclared count ages silently

what_declaring_it_exposed.cause: the query is a SLIDING window, datetime('now','-24 hours'), plus 3-day retention deleting rows underneath it
what_declaring_it_exposed.fix: removed from derivations with a written rationale — an equality check against a monotonically-moving value fails every run and trains the reader to ignore the gate

a_number_i_did_not_publish.tempting: 99 of 121 metrics files have neither a derivation nor a reproducer
a_number_i_did_not_publish.why_i_checked_further: the audit only re-checks what live claims ground in
a_number_i_did_not_publish.and_now: 2 of those 3 were the GQ-008 files, now covered by the declared reproducer
a_number_i_did_not_publish.lesson: 99 would have been alarmism — a true count of the wrong population

five_wrong_keys_in_one_session: grounding ids are under source.id not id; my glob output read as empty when it was filtering correctly; derivations key was right and my reading of the output was wrong. Each cost a round trip. The fix is not care, it is reading the structure first.

result.remaining_findings: 3, all severity info: pre-existing worklog drift and two correct reproducer notes
